   290→	commitIter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
   291→		From: head.Hash(),
   292→	})
   293→	if err != nil {
   294→		return ""
   295→	}
   296→	defer commitIter.Close()
   297→
   298→	count := 0

   300→	for {
   301→		commit, iterErr := commitIter.Next()
   302→		if iterErr != nil {
   303→			break
   304→		}
   305→		count++
   306→		if count > maxCommitsToSearch {
   307→			break

   310→		// Check if this commit has our checkpoint ID
   311→		foundID, hasTrailer := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   312→		if hasTrailer && foundID == checkpointID {

   314→			firstLine := strings.Split(commit.Message, "\n")[0]

   423→var errStopIteration = errors.New("stop iteration")
   424→
   425→// getBranchCheckpoints returns checkpoints relevant to the current branch.
   426→// This is strategy-agnostic - it queries checkpoints directly from the checkpoint store.
   427→//
   428→// Behavior:
   429→//   - On feature branches: only show checkpoints unique to this branch (not in main)
   430→//   - On default branch (main/master): show all checkpoints in history (up to limit)
   431→//   - Includes both committed checkpoints (entire/sessions) and temporary checkpoints (shadow branches)
   432→func getBranchCheckpoints(repo *git.Repository, limit int) ([]strategy.RewindPoint, error) {
   433→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   434→
   435→	// Get all committed checkpoints for lookup
   436→	committedInfos, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
   437→	if err != nil {
   438→		committedInfos = nil // Continue without committed checkpoints
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	// Build map of checkpoint ID -> committed info
   442→	committedByID := make(map[id.CheckpointID]checkpoint.CommittedInfo)
   443→	for _, info := range committedInfos {
   444→		if !info.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   445→			committedByID[info.CheckpointID] = info
   446→		}
   447→	}
   448→
   449→	head, err := repo.Head()
   450→	if err != nil {
   451→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   452→	}
   453→
   454→	// Check if we're on the default branch
   455→	isOnDefault, _, _ := IsOnDefaultBranch() //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort, defaults to false
   456→	var mainBranchHash plumbing.Hash
   457→	if !isOnDefault {
   458→		mainBranchHash = strategy.GetMainBranchHash(repo)
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	// Walk git history and collect checkpoints
   462→	iter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
   463→		From:  head.Hash(),
   464→		Order: git.LogOrderCommitterTime,
   465→	})
   466→	if err != nil {
   467→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   468→	}
   469→
   470→	var points []strategy.RewindPoint
   471→	count := 0
   472→	consecutiveMainCount := 0
   473→
   474→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   475→		if count >= commitScanLimit {
   476→			return errStopIteration
   477→		}
   478→		count++
   479→
   480→		// On feature branches, skip commits that are reachable from main
   481→		// (but continue scanning - there may be more feature branch commits)
   482→		if mainBranchHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
   483→			if isAncestorOf(repo, c.Hash, mainBranchHash) {
   484→				consecutiveMainCount++
   485→				if consecutiveMainCount >= consecutiveMainLimit {
   486→					return errStopIteration // Likely exhausted feature branch commits
   487→				}
   488→				return nil // Skip this commit, continue scanning
   489→			}
   490→			consecutiveMainCount = 0 // Reset on feature branch commit
   491→		}
   492→
   493→		// Extract checkpoint ID from Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   494→		cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(c.Message)
   495→		if !found {
   496→			return nil // No checkpoint trailer, continue
   497→		}
   498→
   499→		// Look up checkpoint info
   500→		cpInfo, found := committedByID[cpID]
   501→		if !found {
   502→			return nil // Checkpoint not in store, continue
   503→		}
   504→
   505→		// Create rewind point from committed info
   506→		message := strings.Split(c.Message, "\n")[0]
   507→		point := strategy.RewindPoint{
   508→			ID:           c.Hash.String(),
   509→			Message:      message,
   510→			Date:         c.Author.When,
   511→			IsLogsOnly:   true, // Committed checkpoints are logs-only
   512→			CheckpointID: cpID,
   513→			SessionID:    cpInfo.SessionID,
   514→		}
   515→
   516→		// Read session prompt from metadata branch (best-effort)
   517→		if metadataTree, treeErr := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo); treeErr == nil && metadataTree != nil {
   518→			point.SessionPrompt = strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(metadataTree, cpID.Path())
   519→		}
   520→
   521→		points = append(points, point)
   522→		return nil
   523→	})
   524→
   525→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStopIteration) {
   526→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	// Also get temporary checkpoints from shadow branch for current HEAD
   530→	headShort := head.Hash().String()[:7]
   531→	tempCheckpoints, _ := store.ListTemporaryCheckpoints(context.Background(), headShort, "", limit) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort, continue without temp checkpoints
   532→	for _, tc := range tempCheckpoints {
   533→		shadowCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(tc.CommitHash)
   534→		if commitErr != nil {
   535→			continue
   536→		}
   537→
   538→		// Filter out checkpoints with no code changes (only .entire/ metadata changed)
   539→		// This also filters out the first checkpoint which is just a baseline copy
   540→		if !hasCodeChanges(shadowCommit) {
   541→			continue
   542→		}
   543→
   544→		// Read session prompt from the shadow branch commit's tree (not from entire/sessions)
   545→		// Temporary checkpoints store their metadata in the shadow branch, not in entire/sessions
   546→		var sessionPrompt string
   547→		shadowTree, treeErr := shadowCommit.Tree()
   548→		if treeErr == nil {
   549→			sessionPrompt = strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(shadowTree, tc.MetadataDir)
   550→		}
   551→
   552→		points = append(points, strategy.RewindPoint{
   553→			ID:               tc.CommitHash.String(),
   554→			Message:          tc.Message,
   555→			MetadataDir:      tc.MetadataDir,
   556→			Date:             tc.Timestamp,
   557→			IsTaskCheckpoint: tc.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   558→			ToolUseID:        tc.ToolUseID,
   559→			SessionID:        tc.SessionID,
   560→			SessionPrompt:    sessionPrompt,
   561→			IsLogsOnly:       false, // Temporary checkpoints can be fully rewound
   562→		})
   563→	}
   564→
   565→	// Sort by date, most recent first
   566→	sort.Slice(points, func(i, j int) bool {
   567→		return points[i].Date.After(points[j].Date)
   568→	})
   569→
   570→	// Apply limit
   571→	if len(points) > limit {
   572→		points = points[:limit]
   573→	}
   574→
   575→	return points, nil
   576→}

   578→// isAncestorOf checks if commit is an ancestor of (or equal to) target.
   579→// Returns true if target can reach commit by following parent links.
   580→func isAncestorOf(repo *git.Repository, commit, target plumbing.Hash) bool {
   581→	if commit == target {
   582→		return true
   583→	}
   584→
   585→	iter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{From: target})
   586→	if err != nil {
   587→		return false
   588→	}
   589→
   590→	found := false
   591→	count := 0
   592→	_ = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error { //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort search, errors are non-fatal
   593→		count++
   594→		if count > 1000 {
   595→			return errStopIteration
   596→		}
   597→		if c.Hash == commit {
   598→			found = true
   599→			return errStopIteration
   600→		}
   601→		return nil
   602→	})
   603→
   604→	return found
   605→}

   610→	repo, err := openRepository()

   687→// gatherCurrentSessionDetails attempts to get transcript info for sessions without checkpoints.
   688→// This handles strategies like shadow where active sessions may not have checkpoint commits.
   689→func gatherCurrentSessionDetails(strat strategy.Strategy, session *strategy.Session) []checkpointDetail {
   690→	// Try to get transcript via GetSessionContext which reads from metadata branch
   691→	// For shadow, we can read the transcript from the same location pattern
   692→	contextContent := strat.GetSessionContext(session.ID)
   693→	if contextContent == "" {
   694→		return nil
   695→	}
   696→
   697→	// Parse the context.md to extract the last prompt/summary
   698→	// Context.md typically has sections like "# Prompt\n...\n## Summary\n..."
   699→	detail := checkpointDetail{
   700→		Index:     1,
   701→		Timestamp: session.StartTime,
   702→		Message:   "Current session",
   703→	}
   704→
   705→	// Try to extract prompt and summary from context.md
   706→	lines := strings.Split(contextContent, "\n")
   707→	var inPrompt, inSummary bool
   708→	var promptLines, summaryLines []string
   709→
   710→	for _, line := range lines {
   711→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   712→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "# ") && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "prompt") {
   713→			inPrompt = true
   714→			inSummary = false
   715→			continue
   716→		}
   717→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "summary") {
   718→			inPrompt = false
   719→			inSummary = true
   720→			continue
   721→		}
   722→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "# ") {
   723→			inPrompt = false
   724→			inSummary = false
   725→			continue
   726→		}
   727→
   728→		if inPrompt {
   729→			promptLines = append(promptLines, line)
   730→		} else if inSummary {
   731→			summaryLines = append(summaryLines, line)
   732→		}
   733→	}
   734→
   735→	var inter interaction
   736→	if len(promptLines) > 0 {
   737→		inter.Prompt = strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(promptLines, "\n"))
   738→	}
   739→	if len(summaryLines) > 0 {
   740→		inter.Responses = []string{strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(summaryLines, "\n"))}
   741→	}
   742→
   743→	// If we couldn't parse structured content, show the raw context
   744→	if inter.Prompt == "" && len(inter.Responses) == 0 {
   745→		inter.Responses = []string{contextContent}
   746→	}
   747→
   748→	if inter.Prompt != "" || len(inter.Responses) > 0 {
   749→		detail.Interactions = []interaction{inter}
   750→	}
   751→
   752→	return []checkpointDetail{detail}
   753→}

   755→// gatherCheckpointDetails extracts detailed information for each checkpoint.
   756→// Checkpoints come in newest-first order, but we number them oldest=1, newest=N.
   757→func gatherCheckpointDetails(strat strategy.Strategy, session *strategy.Session) []checkpointDetail {
   758→	details := make([]checkpointDetail, 0, len(session.Checkpoints))
   759→	total := len(session.Checkpoints)
   760→
   761→	for i, cp := range session.Checkpoints {
   762→		detail := checkpointDetail{
   763→			Index:            total - i, // Reverse numbering: oldest=1, newest=N
   764→			Timestamp:        cp.Timestamp,
   765→			IsTaskCheckpoint: cp.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   766→			Message:          cp.Message,
   767→		}
   768→
   769→		// Use checkpoint ID for display (truncate long IDs)
   770→		detail.ShortID = cp.CheckpointID.String()
   771→		if len(detail.ShortID) > 12 {
   772→			detail.ShortID = detail.ShortID[:12]
   773→		}
   774→
   775→		// Try to get transcript for this checkpoint
   776→		transcriptContent, err := strat.GetCheckpointLog(cp)
   777→		if err == nil {
   778→			transcript, parseErr := parseTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptContent)
   779→			if parseErr == nil {
   780→				// Extract all prompt/response pairs from the transcript
   781→				pairs := ExtractAllPromptResponses(transcript)
   782→				for _, pair := range pairs {
   783→					detail.Interactions = append(detail.Interactions, interaction(pair))
   784→				}
   785→
   786→				// Aggregate all files for the checkpoint
   787→				fileSet := make(map[string]bool)
   788→				for _, pair := range pairs {
   789→					for _, f := range pair.Files {
   790→						if !fileSet[f] {
   791→							fileSet[f] = true
   792→							detail.Files = append(detail.Files, f)
   793→						}
   794→					}
   795→				}
   796→			}
   797→		}
   798→
   799→		details = append(details, detail)
   800→	}
   801→
   802→	return details
   803→}

   805→// runExplainCommit explains a specific commit.
   806→func runExplainCommit(w io.Writer, commitRef string) error {
   807→	repo, err := openRepository()
   808→	if err != nil {
   809→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   810→	}
   811→
   812→	// Resolve the commit reference
   813→	hash, err := repo.ResolveRevision(plumbing.Revision(commitRef))
   814→	if err != nil {
   815→		return fmt.Errorf("commit not found: %s", commitRef)
   816→	}
   817→
   818→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(*hash)
   819→	if err != nil {
   820→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
   821→	}
   822→
   823→	// Get files changed in this commit (diff from parent to current)
   824→	var files []string
   825→	commitTree, err := commit.Tree()
   826→	if err == nil && commit.NumParents() > 0 {
   827→		parent, parentErr := commit.Parent(0)
   828→		if parentErr == nil {
   829→			parentTree, treeErr := parent.Tree()
   830→			if treeErr == nil {
   831→				// Diff from parent to current commit to show what changed
   832→				changes, diffErr := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
   833→				if diffErr == nil {
   834→					for _, change := range changes {
   835→						name := change.To.Name
   836→						if name == "" {
   837→							name = change.From.Name
   838→						}
   839→						files = append(files, name)
   840→					}
   841→				}
   842→			}
   843→		}
   844→	}
   845→
   846→	// Check for Entire metadata
   847→	metadataDir, hasMetadata := trailers.ParseMetadata(commit.Message)
   848→	sessionID, hasSession := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   849→
   850→	// If no session trailer, try to extract from metadata path.
   851→	// Note: extractSessionIDFromMetadata is defined in rewind.go as it's used
   852→	// by both the rewind and explain commands for parsing metadata paths.
   853→	if !hasSession && hasMetadata {
   854→		sessionID = extractSessionIDFromMetadata(metadataDir)
   855→		hasSession = sessionID != ""
   856→	}
   857→
   858→	// Build commit info
   859→	fullSHA := hash.String()
   860→	shortSHA := fullSHA
   861→	if len(fullSHA) >= 7 {
   862→		shortSHA = fullSHA[:7]
   863→	}
   864→
   865→	info := &commitInfo{
   866→		SHA:       fullSHA,
   867→		ShortSHA:  shortSHA,
   868→		Message:   strings.Split(commit.Message, "\n")[0], // First line only
   869→		Author:    commit.Author.Name,
   870→		Email:     commit.Author.Email,
   871→		Date:      commit.Author.When,
   872→		Files:     files,
   873→		HasEntire: hasMetadata || hasSession,
   874→		SessionID: sessionID,
   875→	}
   876→
   877→	// Format and output
   878→	output := formatCommitInfo(info)
   879→	fmt.Fprint(w, output)
   880→
   881→	return nil
   882→}

   884→// formatSessionInfo formats session information for display.
   885→func formatSessionInfo(session *strategy.Session, sourceRef string, checkpoints []checkpointDetail) string {
   886→	var sb strings.Builder
   887→
   888→	// Session header
   889→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Session: %s\n", session.ID)
   890→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Strategy: %s\n", session.Strategy)
   891→
   892→	if !session.StartTime.IsZero() {
   893→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Started: %s\n", session.StartTime.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   894→	}
   895→
   896→	if sourceRef != "" {
   897→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Source Ref: %s\n", sourceRef)
   898→	}
   899→
   900→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Checkpoints: %d\n", len(checkpoints))
   901→
   902→	// Checkpoint details
   903→	for _, cp := range checkpoints {
   904→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   905→
   906→		// Checkpoint header
   907→		taskMarker := ""
   908→		if cp.IsTaskCheckpoint {
   909→			taskMarker = " [Task]"
   910→		}
   911→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "─── Checkpoint %d [%s] %s%s ───\n",
   912→			cp.Index, cp.ShortID, cp.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04"), taskMarker)
   913→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   914→
   915→		// Display all interactions in this checkpoint
   916→		for i, inter := range cp.Interactions {
   917→			// For multiple interactions, add a sub-header
   918→			if len(cp.Interactions) > 1 {
   919→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "### Interaction %d\n\n", i+1)
   920→			}
   921→
   922→			// Prompt section
   923→			if inter.Prompt != "" {
   924→				sb.WriteString("## Prompt\n\n")
   925→				sb.WriteString(inter.Prompt)
   926→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   927→			}
   928→
   929→			// Response section
   930→			if len(inter.Responses) > 0 {
   931→				sb.WriteString("## Responses\n\n")
   932→				sb.WriteString(strings.Join(inter.Responses, "\n\n"))
   933→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   934→			}
   935→
   936→			// Files modified for this interaction
   937→			if len(inter.Files) > 0 {
   938→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Files Modified (%d):\n", len(inter.Files))
   939→				for _, file := range inter.Files {
   940→					fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  - %s\n", file)
   941→				}
   942→				sb.WriteString("\n")
   943→			}
   944→		}
   945→
   946→		// If no interactions, show message and/or files
   947→		if len(cp.Interactions) == 0 {
   948→			// Show commit message as summary when no transcript available
   949→			if cp.Message != "" {
   950→				sb.WriteString(cp.Message)
   951→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   952→			}
   953→			// Show aggregate files if available
   954→			if len(cp.Files) > 0 {
   955→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Files Modified (%d):\n", len(cp.Files))
   956→				for _, file := range cp.Files {
   957→					fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  - %s\n", file)
   958→				}
   959→			}
   960→		}
   961→	}
   962→
   963→	return sb.String()
   964→}

   966→// formatCommitInfo formats commit information for display.
   967→func formatCommitInfo(info *commitInfo) string {
   968→	var sb strings.Builder
   969→
   970→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Commit: %s (%s)\n", info.SHA, info.ShortSHA)
   971→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Date: %s\n", info.Date.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   972→
   973→	if info.HasEntire && info.SessionID != "" {
   974→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Session: %s\n", info.SessionID)
   975→	}
   976→
   977→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   978→
   979→	// Message
   980→	sb.WriteString("Message:\n")
   981→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  %s\n", info.Message)
   982→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   983→
   984→	// Files modified
   985→	if len(info.Files) > 0 {
   986→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Files Modified (%d):\n", len(info.Files))
   987→		for _, file := range info.Files {
   988→			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  - %s\n", file)
   989→		}
   990→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   991→	}
   992→
   993→	// Note for non-Entire commits
   994→	if !info.HasEntire {
   995→		sb.WriteString("Note: No Entire session data available for this commit.\n")
   996→	}
   997→
   998→	return sb.String()
   999→}

  1001→// outputWithPager outputs content through a pager if stdout is a terminal and content is long.
  1002→func outputWithPager(w io.Writer, content string) {

  1004→	if f, ok := w.(*os.File); ok && f == os.Stdout && term.IsTerminal(int(f.Fd())) {
